scope: Projectivy 4.73 per-channel Sliding row behavior for AuraMusic card focus

procedure.navigation: DPAD right Angie→Africa, then DPAD left Africa→Angie; no Select/click

assertions.on_focus_bounds: PASS; Angie and Africa both [0,535][486,775], showing focus stays in fixed slot while row slides
assertions.off_focus_bounds: PASS; Angie [0,535][486,775], Africa [326,535][882,775], showing focus follows stationary card position
assertions.original_projectivy_setting_restored: PASS; Sliding row enabled after test
assertions.exact_old_preview_pixels_cross_card_boun: INCONCLUSIVE; this test measures Projectivy focus-node bounds and row motion, not isolated Surface pixels

interpretation: Projectivy Sliding row reproduces the fixed-focus-slot row movement described by the user. Disabling it for AuraMusic keeps cards in their row positions while focus moves between them. AuraMusic cannot change this Projectivy preference; the user's original enabled state was restored.
